review.en: Mariya Takeuchi's return after a break from recording, written entirely by herself and produced and arranged by Tatsuro Yamashita. The songs range from sixties-style pop to polished adult soul, all cleanly crafted. Plastic Love, a modest single in its day, became an online phenomenon more than thirty years later and led a new generation back to Japanese city pop.
review.zh: 竹内玛莉亚暂停录音一段时间后的回归之作，全部歌曲由她自己写，山下达郎制作和编曲。曲风从六十年代式的流行到精致的成人灵魂乐，做工干净。《Plastic Love》当年只是一首不算大热的单曲，三十多年后在网络上走红，把新一代听众带回了日本城市流行。
